placement: Shared media/eth PLL fixed x000y000 as in passed shared-clock build; RX PLL x000y071 as in passed AV diagnostic. Fixed 2x4 regions for raw pairs: lane0 {38 8}, lane1 {38 12}. Related 50MHz paths remain timed; no hold-violation false paths.
timing_modes: tx_local_serial and tx_external_serial share CSB output and preserve real source-clock relationships. Reports include local-source -> local-TX and external-source -> external-TX paths, including internal DDR/reset paths. Other genuinely independent domains are asynchronous. External data -> first phase-trained input IOL remains excepted; input eye requires board regression.
drc: No multi-drive, no abnormal timing path. Original vendor SDRAM location hints are relocated (PHY-7002), and one clock has a local segment (PHY-5079); both disclosed and routed STA covers actual mapping. No other critical warnings allowed by gate.
ports: PC HDMI -> HDMIA; HDMIB -> monitor for BOTH museum and passthrough
priority: Qualified external AV always wins, including emergency/help. Without valid source, original local terminal displays its current state. No new MBP1 commands or key/switch allocation.
switch: Single four-lane ODDR bank with native forced CSB clock mux. Assert mute, wait 8 application clocks, switch clocks, settle >=1ms with target ready, wait synchronized blank/control indication, then release reset through 4 serial clocks. Stopped-HIGH and stopped-LOW source clocks cannot trap fallback. Monitor relock time is not guaranteed seamless.
media: Original media/network continue on original clocks. Only local HDMI physical output is bypassed by default-off EXTERNAL_HDMI_PHY; RGB encoder reused from vendor, original toggle/shift serializer exposed as pairs. No SDRAM passthrough frame buffers, no local-media reload on HDMI loss.
audio: Original four raw TMDS lanes forwarded together, including clock/data islands/ACR/InfoFrames. Official AnlogicHDMI EDID retained: 720p60, two-channel 48kHz 24-bit LPCM. Local display remains original video-only output; passthrough sound goes to HDMI monitor, not local amplifier.
simulation_limit: Integrated HDMI test uses scaled geometry, real vendor encoder/PLL/IOL/CSB models and a media/network background-clock stub; actual media, keys, MBP1, pages and cache paths are separately regressed. Not full-system electrical/SDF simulation or a valid generated LPCM/BCH packet. Startup unknown-operand warnings from unchanged vendor VHDL are disclosed; equivalence checks reject unknown outputs after warmup.
